versions.subject: feat: new rules and update
versions.detection:
selection_ldif:
    - Image|endswith: '\ldifde.exe'
    - OriginalFileName: 'ldifde.exe'
selection_cmd:
    CommandLine|contains|all:
        - '-f'
filter_import:
    CommandLine|contains: ' -i'
condition: all of selection_* and not 1 of filter_*
versions.spl: Image="*\\ldifde.exe" OR OriginalFileName="ldifde.exe" CommandLine="*-f*" NOT CommandLine="* -i*"
